# Leaguepedia fixtures

`worlds-2024-subset.json` contains real rows recorded from the
[Leaguepedia](https://lol.fandom.com/) Cargo API: three Worlds 2024 series (a play-in Bo3, a
Swiss Bo1 and the Bo5 final) with their games, drafts, player stats, rosters and results.
Tests use it so they never touch the network.

Like the dataset in `data/`, these rows are licensed under
[CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/), not under the repository's
MIT license.
